desks.Dividends: Microsoft, ex Thu Nov 19 at $0.98 per quarter (pay Dec 10), is the only declared watchlist ex-date in the next four weeks, its 24th consecutive annual increase, and the last purchase day for entitlement is Wed Nov 18. The $0.98 has been public since Sep 15, so no information edge attaches to the ex-date itself. Apple's dividend is still undeclared; a mid-November date is pattern-plausible but UNVERIFIED until declared, and a declaration could accompany tonight's earnings release, so re-check before Tuesday's open. Nvidia's next declaration normally accompanies its Nov 17 earnings, pointing to an early-December ex-date outside the window. SPY and QQQ point to mid-December on pattern only, Tesla pays no dividend, and no cuts or specials were found.
desks.Earnings: Apple reports Mon Nov 2 after close (call 5:00 p.m. ET), fiscal quarter ending Sep 2026, with Nasdaq consensus EPS of $1.98 from 7 estimates. The Nov 4 expiry straddle implies a move of about 4.6% and the Nov 6 weekly about 5.0%, against a mean absolute first-session move of 2.46% over the last eight reports (2 up, 6 down, signed mean -1.53%). Microsoft reported Oct 28 and Tesla reported Oct 21. Nvidia reports Tue Nov 17 after close, just outside this window; some secondary calendars say Nov 18, likely a timezone-label difference.
desks.Futures: Front-month crude fell about 6% on Nov 2 on Doha diplomacy hopes, with Brent at about $106.45 (-6.15%) and WTI below $100, while December 2027 Brent fell only $2.41 — the curve drains a front-month war premium about three times faster than the deferred premium. Attacks continued through Nov 2 and no US acceptance of terms was found, so the curve prices a negotiation, not a settlement. Physical tightness survives the headline: EIA crude about 4% below the five-year average and distillates about 10% below. OPEC+ held December targets unchanged Sun Nov 1. Next catalysts in order: EIA petroleum Wed Nov 4 at 10:30 a.m. ET, USDA WASDE Tue Nov 10 at 12:00 p.m. ET, OPEC+ ministerial Sun Nov 29.
desks.Parity: No published put-call or box parity violation was found for the watchlist. The S&P Dow Jones style-index methodology overhaul, with pro-forma files Dec 4 and effective before the open Dec 21, changes growth/value classification, not S&P 500 membership, and matters for style-ETF rebalancing flow around Dec 4-21, not for parity math. A cited estimate puts at least $375 billion in passive funds tied to the affected gauges, attributed and not desk-verified. A preprint on SPX and RUT parity residuals describes a funding and capital wedge around year-end expiries, not a visible arbitrage failure, which supports the standing rule that parity math wins over a screen or model.
desks.Premium: Apple's front implied volatility of 64.4% against 14.9% trailing realized volatility is event pricing ahead of tonight's print, not a mispricing signal, and premium into the binary is to be avoided; the term structure slopes steeply down from the 2-day expiry (63.8%) to about 31.5% at 25 days. SPY has no clean implied-versus-realized verdict: a single day drives 32.23% of the 20-day realized variance, over the 30% line, so the read is WINDOW-CONTINGENT, and QQQ at 29.8% sits just under the line and is one heavy day from tripping it. Tesla, Microsoft and Nvidia run 15 to 17 points above trailing realized on live front prints, but with no earnings inside their front windows and short-dated tenor effects in play, that is a flag, not a sell signal. Implied-volatility rank is UNVERIFIED for all six names.
desks.Quant lab: Five new candidates were appended to the ledger as rows 201-205, with one WATCH and four ARCHIVE, and no TEST and no INTEGRATE movement this run. The WATCH item is the QBX compiler for well-formed, auditable alpha programs (score 50, accepted at ICAIF 2026), valued for its availability-checker discipline that makes look-ahead violations structurally unrepresentable in a backtest pipeline, the same failure class the purged walk-forward lane exists to prevent. It stays WATCH until code appears. The GitHub new-repo discovery leg was skipped this run, and re-checks for rows 9, 21 and 31 were deferred after transient arXiv errors.

items.detail: FRED prints dated Fri Oct 30, the latest trading day before this Monday run, put the effective fed funds rate at 3.88%, the 2-year at 4.56% and the 10-year at 4.94%, a 2s10s spread of +38 basis points after narrowing 5 points over the 60-day window. SOFR at 3.95% sits 7 basis points over the effective fed funds rate, a normal overnight funding print with no stress signal. Near 5%, the 10-year remains a valuation headwind for long-duration names on discount-rate grounds: a value lens demands a wider margin of safety on long-duration growth exposure, not a volatility signal.
